changelog:
byted-las-document-parse 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for parsing PDF documents and images (including long screenshots and scanned documents).
- Extracts structured content (text, tables, images) and outputs in Markdown format.
- Supports both local files and URLs, with automatic mode selection (normal/detail) and process workflow.
- Handles asynchronous task submission, user feedback, and result retrieval (including background and fallback polling).
- Environment setup and resume capability for interrupted sessions included.
- Guides user with detailed workflow and troubleshooting tips in the documentation.
